processes_loading: Looking at what's using this computer…
agents_none: No Agents are running on this computer.
stop_idle_note: Their conversations stay, and a new message picks each one up again. Agents that are working or need you are never stopped.
stop_idle_none: No idle Agents to stop: Agents that are working, need you or still run something are never stopped.
stop_confirm_body: These Agents on {machine} will quit and free the memory they use. Their conversations stay, so you can pick them up later.
disk_loading: Looking at what's using the disk…
folders_title: Largest folders in your home folder
folders_partial: The scan ran out of time; these are the folders it got to.
caches_none: No caches to clean were found.
caches_unavailable: This computer's caches can't be seen, so nothing can be cleaned right now.
clean_note: Tools download or rebuild these again when they need them. Container data is never touched.
clean_confirm_body: These folders on {machine} will be emptied, {size} in total:
clean_confirm_safe: Anything in use when the cleanup runs is skipped. These caches are rebuilt when needed.
build_hub_unknown: The hub's build isn't known here, so only this computer's is shown.
build_gap_unknown: Can't tell how far apart the two builds are.
build_older: This computer's build is {gap} older than the hub's.
build_newer: This computer's build is {gap} newer than the hub's.
build_same_time: Both builds were made at the same time.
mismatch_why: Persona on this computer isn't the same deployment as the hub. Features may not line up and new ones won't work here until it's redeployed to match.
mismatch_working_one: {count} Agent is working now; a redeploy waits for it to go idle.
mismatch_working_other: {count} Agents are working now; a redeploy waits for them to go idle.
mismatch_none_working: No Agents are working right now.
deploy_still_mismatch: The update ended but the build still doesn't match the hub's.
redeploy_confirm_body: The Persona node on {machine} will be updated and restarted; the computer goes offline for a moment.
redeploy_confirm_working_one: {count} Agent is working; the update waits until it's idle.
redeploy_confirm_working_other: {count} Agents are working; the update waits until they're idle.
redeploy_confirm_idle: No Agents are working, so it starts right away.
last_seen_unknown: When it was last online isn't known.
check_auth_1: Open Persona Link on that computer and check it's still paired with this hub.
check_auth_2: If it was paired again or the hub's address changed, pair it again with Add computer on the Machines page.
check_auth_3: For a computer reached over SSH: check the hub machine's key is still in its authorized keys.
check_unreachable_1: Is the computer on and awake?
check_unreachable_2: Is it on the network (Wi-Fi, cable or VPN)?
check_unreachable_3: Is Persona Link running on it?
check_unreachable_4: Once all of that is fine, press Reconnect.
check_timeout_1: Is the computer asleep, or is its lid closed?
check_timeout_2: Is its network slow or dropping out?
check_timeout_3: Press Reconnect; if it keeps timing out, restart Persona Link on that computer.
check_version_1: Persona on this computer can't work with the hub's version.
check_version_2: Redeploy from here if you can; otherwise update Persona on that computer.
check_node_service_down_1: Persona Link is installed, but its background service isn't running.
check_node_service_down_2: Open Persona Link on that computer to start it, or restart the computer.
check_link_offline_1: Persona Link on that computer isn't connected to the hub.
check_link_offline_2: Check the computer is on and online.
check_link_offline_3: Open Persona Link and check it says it's connected.
check_never_connected_1: Finish setting it up on that computer with the pairing link.
check_never_connected_2: Keep it on and online until it shows up here.
check_unknown_1: Is the computer on and awake?
check_unknown_3: Is Persona Link running on it?
check_unknown_4: Press Reconnect; if that doesn't help, look at the details below.
launcher_onboarding: First-run setup (style, sign-in) isn't finished on this computer
launcher_all_ok: Every launcher on this computer works now.
launcher_why: A failing launcher can't start new Agents on this computer. Persona keeps retrying and repairs what it can; new Agents use a launcher that works.
launcher_alternatives: Launchers that work on this computer
launcher_no_alternative: No other launcher works on this computer right now.
launcher_switch_note: Which launcher new Agents use is chosen in Model settings.
handoff_intro: Pick the work and the computer to take it over. Persona continues it there, then stops the original Agents on {machine}.
handoff_needs_you: Waiting for you; answer it first
handoff_none_eligible: No computer can take this over right now.
handoff_note: The conversation isn't moved: the new Agent picks up from a short brief.
handoff_confirm_body_one: Move {count} piece of work from {source} to {target}:
handoff_confirm_body_other: Move {count} pieces of work from {source} to {target}:
handoff_confirm_note: Persona handles it in the main chat and tells you how it went; the Agents on {source} stop only after the new ones have started.
mismatch_resolved: Persona on this computer is now the same deployment as the hub.
mismatch_hosted_managers: Redeploying updates the shared personad program; co-located assistant ({names}) will restart smoothly once idle.
deploy_done_pending_restart: Co-located assistant ({names}) is busy and will restart automatically once idle to switch to the new build.
redeploy_confirm_managers: Co-located assistant ({names}) shares personad on this computer and will restart smoothly once idle.
